_doc: Permanent shop upgrades. effect = per_level * level (after soft_cap each level only adds after_cap). Cost to buy level L+1 = cost_base * (L+1)^cost_exp, x cost_softcap_mult past the soft cap; or cost_list for short tracks. max_level 0 = unlimited. Tuned so a typical player's damage/HP tracks the generator's player_power / player_hp curves (see docs/BALANCE.md, Economy).

summon.name: Necromancy
summon.desc: Start each run with {effect} skeleton allies
